_note: Every vendor-diverse critic round that exists as a runbook (or, for CMP-1, E2E-1 and REM-1, the generic NEW runbook added with this harness). Paths are repo-relative. 'ref' = read the file from that git ref of the protocol clone instead of the working tree (the WP5 and Functions material live on other branches). A critic gets ONLY the files listed here plus its runbook.
